title: Headteachers say families will struggle after another rise in school dinner prices
summary: The price of a school dinner in a primary school will have risen from £2.60 to £3.40 since the start of 2026.

title: Nvidia Intervened in US Megaspeed Chip Smuggling Probe
summary: Nvidia's general counsel intervened in a US government probe of suspected smuggling of AI chips by Megaspeed International. Bloomberg's Lynn Doan and Annabelle Droulers explain what we know. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US supreme court clears way for Trump’s border wall in Texas’s Big Bend
summary: Ruling said law enacted by Congress reflects preference for border control over environmental and recreational harm The US supreme court has allowed Donald Trump to continue his administration’s construction of a border wall in Texas’s Big Bend region, including parts of Big Bend national park.
